results.snippet:
【智迅文化 2026 年 07 月 24 日讯】7月22日，小鹏汽车董事长何小鹏在广州MONA L03首批车主交付仪式上宣布，MONA M03 Ultra SE版本将提前至7月内开启交付，较原计划8月交付提前了近一个月。此前2026款MONA M03于4月2日上市时，Ultra SE版本的交付时间表定在8月。
 提前交付的背后是产能的加速释放。何小鹏透露，7月MONA系列产能正在爬坡，8月和9月每个月的产能都将实现一次跳跃式提升。MONA L03纯电版本目前交付周期为13至17周，8月起将正式开启大批量交付。
MONA M03 Ultra SE版本提供510长续航和610超长续航两款配置，售价分别为14.18万元和15.18万元。该版本搭载双图灵AI芯片与第二代VLA智驾系统，算力达1500TOPS，是MONA M03系列中智驾能力最强的版本。

results.title: Xpeng Begins Deliveries of Mona L03 as Production Ramps Up to Meet Strong Demand
results.snippet:
XPeng
Xpeng Begins Deliveries of Mona L03 as Production Ramps Up to Meet Strong...
Credit: Xpeng
Xpeng has begun delivering its new Mona L03 sport utility vehicle to customers in China, as the electric vehicle manufacturer accelerates production to meet strong demand following the model’s market launch earlier this month.
The company said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer He Xiaopeng personally handed over keys to some of the first customers, while production facilities are operating at full capacity to increase output.
Deliveries Begin After Strong Launch Demand
The Mona L03 was introduced in China on July 16 with a starting price of 123,800 yuan ($18,200).
The model is offered in both battery-electric vehicle (BEV) and extended-range electric vehicle (EREV) variants, continuing Xpeng’s strategy of providing multiple powertrain options.
According to the company, the vehicle received more than 20,000 confirmed orders within seven minutes of its launch, with total firm orders reaching 46,859 units during the first hour.
The relatively short period between launch and the start of deliveries reflects Xpeng’s efforts to convert customer orders into vehicle sales while minimizing delivery wait times.
Production Increases Amid Supply Constraints
Despite expanding production, supply constraints remain for the new model.
Deutsche Bank said in a research note published on July 21, citing dealer information, that the Mona L03 has accumulated more than 50,000 non-cancellable orders across China. According to the report, more than 40,000 orders were placed for the battery-electric version, while over 10,000 were for the extended-range model.
Current delivery estimates indicate waiting times of between 13 and 17 weeks for the BEV version and between 8 and 12 weeks for the EREV model.
Deutsche Bank said dealers attributed the strong customer response to the vehicle’s lower-than-expected pricing and exterior styling, adding that women account for approximately 70% of total orders.
Xpeng also said recent test-drive activity for the Mona L03 reached the highest level recorded for any of the company’s models at a comparable stage following launch, contributing to record overall showroom traffic across its product lineup.

Snippet.Text: 【智迅文化 2026 年 07 月 24 日讯】7月22日，小鹏汽车董事长何小鹏在广州MONA L03首批车主交付仪式上宣布，MONA M03 Ultra SE版本将提前至7月内开启交付，较原计划8月交付提前了近一个月。此前2026款MONA M03于4月2日上市时，Ultra SE版本的交付时间表定在8月。

提前交付的背后是产能的加速释放。何小鹏透露，7月MONA系列产能正在爬坡，8月和9月每个月的产能都将实现一次跳跃式提升。MONA L03纯电版本目前交付周期为13至17周，8月起将正式开启大批量交付。
MONA M03 Ultra SE版本提供510长续航和610超长续航两款配置，售价分别为14.18万元和15.18万元。该版本搭载双图灵AI芯片与第二代VLA智驾系统，算力达1500TOPS，是MONA M03系列中智驾能力最强的版本。

Documents.Title: Xpeng Begins Deliveries of Mona L03 as Production Ramps Up to Meet Strong Demand

Snippet.Text:
XPeng
Xpeng Begins Deliveries of Mona L03 as Production Ramps Up to Meet Strong...
Credit: Xpeng
Xpeng has begun delivering its new Mona L03 sport utility vehicle to customers in China, as the electric vehicle manufacturer accelerates production to meet strong demand following the model’s market launch earlier this month.
The company said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer He Xiaopeng personally handed over keys to some of the first customers, while production facilities are operating at full capacity to increase output.
Deliveries Begin After Strong Launch Demand
The Mona L03 was introduced in China on July 16 with a starting price of 123,800 yuan ($18,200).
The model is offered in both battery-electric vehicle (BEV) and extended-range electric vehicle (EREV) variants, continuing Xpeng’s strategy of providing multiple powertrain options.
According to the company, the vehicle received more than 20,000 confirmed orders within seven minutes of its launch, with total firm orders reaching 46,859 units during the first hour.
The relatively short period between launch and the start of deliveries reflects Xpeng’s efforts to convert customer orders into vehicle sales while minimizing delivery wait times.
Production Increases Amid Supply Constraints
Despite expanding production, supply constraints remain for the new model.
Deutsche Bank said in a research note published on July 21, citing dealer information, that the Mona L03 has accumulated more than 50,000 non-cancellable orders across China. According to the report, more than 40,000 orders were placed for the battery-electric version, while over 10,000 were for the extended-range model.
Current delivery estimates indicate waiting times of between 13 and 17 weeks for the BEV version and between 8 and 12 weeks for the EREV model.
Deutsche Bank said dealers attributed the strong customer response to the vehicle’s lower-than-expected pricing and exterior styling, adding that women account for approximately 70% of total orders.
Xpeng also said recent test-drive activity for the Mona L03 reached the highest level recorded for any of the company’s models at a comparable stage following launch, contributing to record overall showroom traffic across its product lineup.
